{{Top|leg}}
A '''security cardlock breaker''' was a device that was used to bypass security doors with card locks. The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Kyli Ned'Ix]] utilized one during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
